title: fix(deps): drop bottleneck, its last release holds a require cycle
description:
## .what
`bottleneck@2.19.5` (its last release) holds a require cycle, `lib/Bottleneck.js <-> lib/Group.js`. the declapract `test:lint:cycles` check (dpdm, node_modules included) reds every consumer that reaches it through with-bottleneck.

## .ask
back `genBottleneck` with a cycle-free limiter (e.g. an in-house queue, or `p-limit`), same contract, so consumers can drop their `/bottleneck@` exclude.

first seen in rhachet-roles-bhrain `.route/v2026_11_19.declapract.upgrade`, stone 3.1 (fulcrum F4).
reason: dropped: wrong owner: with-bottleneck 0.1.2 holds no bottleneck dep; the prod paths run through @ehmpathy/as-command and wrapper-fns
